Glossary — CFM: airflow volume. Pa: pressure. Free = open delivery; load = against the hose ΔP. Hub = motor barrel the blades sit on. Preview = shape only (sec); Assess = one CFD; Optimize = many. Plot: shape = which run (see legend) · ◆ = Assessed by you · ★ = best in its run · gold ring = best overall (nothing beats it on free, load and efficiency at once) · gold ✕ = stock datasheet. |U| / pressure midplane: cut through the duct center, flow left → right (FRONT/inlet LEFT, OUTLET RIGHT); brighter = faster. axial Uz: fan-face cut colored by axial velocity — blue = forward delivery, red = reverse/recirculation (a stalled fan reads red). streamlines: lines through the rotor colored by |U|. spanwise: circumferentially averaged p0 / Uz / swirl / incidence vs radius (where along the span free-air work is lost). b2b Cp: blade-to-blade pressure coefficient at 3–5 span stations.
